sloka: अदृष्टामः च विचेष्यामि देशान् रावण पालितान् ।आपान शाला विचिताः तथा पुष्प गृहाणि च ॥५-१२-१२॥
transliteration: adṛṣṭāmaḥ ca viceṣyāmi deśān rāvaṇa pālitān ।āpāna śālā vicitāḥ tathā puṣpa gṛhāṇi ca ॥5-12-12॥

translations.english: 'I have searched the banquet halls, bowers of creepers, picture galleries and gymnasiums. I have searched everywhere through the paths of gardens and mansions, harems and the Pushpaka chariot also.
